scope: Coverage and limits from the reviewer final message. This is an attestation, not an independently exported image-view tool trace. Original scores remain in the byte-preserved locked review.
message: Saved review.json in the assigned reviewer-3 directory. Actual viewing coverage includes all twelve outputs and six pairs in the assigned order: 192 original stable screenshots: all three widths; both supplied themes for T1/T2; every T2 work view; notebook, compact, expanded, and second-source views for T3. 36 supplemental originals: pending, error, long-content, and saved-note evidence where supplied. 24 overview images, 61 selected original temporal samples, and 3 benchmark originals. 8 common packet documents, plus my assigned review order. The file records 324 unique packet-relative inspected paths and passed schema, coverage, and file-existence checks. Material limits: no continuous video playback or live interaction was viewed. Natural motion quality, keyboard/focus behavior, physical touch response, persistence, functional save/retry/Stop correctness, offscreen scrolling, and full-document reading remain unassessed. T3 had only the supplied light appearance. Typography judgments used original screenshots, without measured contrast or font-scaling tests.
